WITH new_user AS (
  INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, consent_at)
  VALUES ($1, crypt($2, gen_salt('bf', 10)), now())
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, username
), new_session AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, user_id, expires_at)
  SELECT $3, id, now() + interval '2 hours' FROM new_user
  ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE
    SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, created_at = now()
  RETURNING user_id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM new_user) AS authenticated,
  (SELECT id FROM new_user) AS user_id,
  (SELECT username FROM new_user) AS username;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT id, username, failed_login_attempts,
         (locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until > now()) AS locked,
         (locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= now()) AS lock_expired,
         (password_hash = crypt($2, password_hash)) AS valid
  FROM users
  WHERE lower(username) = lower($1)
), ok AS (
  UPDATE users u SET failed_login_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL
  FROM target t
  WHERE u.id = t.id AND NOT t.locked AND t.valid
  RETURNING u.id, u.username
), ko AS (
  UPDATE users u SET
    failed_login_attempts = CASE WHEN t.lock_expired THEN 1 ELSE t.failed_login_attempts + 1 END,
    locked_until = CASE
      WHEN (CASE WHEN t.lock_expired THEN 1 ELSE t.failed_login_attempts + 1 END) >= 5
      THEN now() + interval '15 minutes'
      ELSE NULL
    END
  FROM target t
  WHERE u.id = t.id AND NOT t.locked AND NOT t.valid
  RETURNING u.id
), new_session AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, user_id, expires_at)
  SELECT $3, id, now() + interval '2 hours' FROM ok
  ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE
    SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, created_at = now()
  RETURNING user_id
), cleanup AS (
  DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at <= now()
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ok) AS authenticated,
  (SELECT id FROM ok) AS user_id,
  (SELECT username FROM ok) AS username;
